subject.title: fix(msteams): escape markup in mention display names

question: Should this PR wait for redacted real Teams send/render proof, or may maintainers waive that gate based on the Microsoft mention contract, parser checks, jsdom structural checks, and loopback wire-capture evidence?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and source-backed, but the changed behavior is an external Teams delivery/rendering path and the available proof stops before a real Teams connector or client.

options.title: Require real Teams proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Teams screenshot, recording, send log, runtime output, or linked artifact showing a display name with `&`, `<`, or `>` delivers as one intended mention.

options.title: Waive the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the local parser and loopback transport proof for this narrow escaping change and proceed with ordinary merge review.

options.title: Pause for Teams owner review
options.body: Keep the PR open until a Teams-area owner decides whether the remaining client-rendering uncertainty is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require real Teams proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Teams screenshot, recording, send log, runtime output, or linked artifact showing a display name with `&`, `<`, or `>` delivers as one intended mention.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the closest merged Teams mention hardening work and is the clearest routing owner for this proof-sufficiency choice.
